scenes.text: Vaccines are one of the greatest achievements of modern medicine and public health everywhere
scenes.subtitle: A 60-second explainer
scenes.narration: Welcome to this short explainer on how vaccines train your immune system step by step.

scenes.title: The process
scenes.narration: A vaccine shows your immune system a harmless piece of a virus, which starts a response and builds protective antibodies.

scenes.title: Key takeaways
scenes.narration: Vaccines train your immune system, they are safe and heavily tested, and they protect the whole community.
